title: G06: Complete NFnext CPU and isolated ensemble performance work
body:
# Complete NFnext CPU and isolated ensemble performance work

## Goal

Complete CPU execution/performance work and independent ensemble state for the
current CPU release milestone. GPU kernels and device qualification move to #474.

## Maintainer GPU scope decision — 2026-11-13

GPU implementation and actual-device qualification are consolidated in #474,
separate from the current CPU release milestone. The maintainer has Apple Metal
hardware locally and no CUDA device or self-hosted NVIDIA runner. Metal and CUDA
require separate execution evidence; neither backend qualifies the other.
GPU requirements remain tracked and unqualified where evidence is missing, but
do not block this issue's CPU acceptance. Compile-only/fallback checks remain
useful and cannot count as device execution. See docs/DECISIONS.md item 17.

## Work

1. Implement shared immutable compilation and independent per-trajectory state,
   RNGs and caches, followed by measured rule-family propensity updates.
2. Implement specialized CPU scaffold/genome representations sharing the general
   execution semantics; compare with pinned native NFsim on representative models.
3. Measure startup, peak memory and throughput with independent correctness checks.
   Provide the common interfaces GPU implementations will consume; do not wait
   for CUDA hardware or GPU completion to finish this CPU work.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `release-nf-ensemble`: CPU concurrency/RNG isolation and native NFsim distribution checks pass with fixed run budgets and error control.
- [ ] `release-capability-coverage-176`: all CPU/ensemble work clauses execute through production entry points with independently checked outputs and measured startup, memory and throughput on main. GPU row backend.gpu and release-nf-gpu are owned by #474.

## Dependencies

#148, #141. GPU issue #474 is a downstream consumer, not a prerequisite.

## Closing rule

Close when all acceptance criteria and work clauses for this issue's stated
scope pass on main with exact source/build identity and downstream artifacts.
No additional maintainer decision or closure approval is required.
